name: thisdid
description: ThisDID.com — DIF Universal W3C DID Resolver.

scripts.vendor:list: echo near-did-resolver webvh-did-resolver plc-did-resolver jwk-did-resolver cheqd-did-resolver dns-did-resolver ens-did-resolver cid-did-resolver ion-did-resolver sol-did-resolver iden3-did-resolver hedera-did-resolver xrpl-did-resolver iota-did-resolver empe-did-resolver dht-did-resolver tz-did-resolver
scripts.install:vendor: git submodule update --init --recursive && for d in did-resolver $(npm run -s vendor:list); do (cd vendor/$d && [ -f package.json ] || { echo "vendor/$d has no package.json — is the submodule initialized?"; exit 1; } && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile) || exit 1; done
scripts.build:vendor: for d in did-resolver $(npm run -s vendor:list); do (cd vendor/$d && pnpm run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && concurrently -k -n drivers,worker,web -c cyan,blue,magenta "npm:dev:drivers" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
